requirements.title: Destructive maintenance over MCP requires an explicit capability grant
requirements.body: Destructive maintenance tools exposed over MCP default to preview-only. They perform destructive work in exactly one condition: an explicit out-of-band capability grant is present in the server environment. Transport kind is excluded from the authority decision, because a proxy can front a local stdio pipe with a shared network surface, so a transport reported as local is uninformative about caller identity. When the grant is absent, the tool returns a preview result whose message names the required grant and the equivalent command-line invocation. The command-line entry point applies its own caller's arguments directly, since that caller already holds local shell authority.

scenarios.title: Proxied local transport yields a preview-only run
given: A destructive maintenance tool is exposed over MCP
The server runs as a stdio subprocess behind a shared proxy
scenarios.when: A client requests a destructive run
then: The tool performs a preview-only run
The response reports that the destructive run was refused
The response names the required grant and the command-line equivalent

scenarios.title: Explicit grant authorizes the destructive run
given: The capability grant is present in the server environment
scenarios.when: A client requests a destructive run
then: The tool applies the caller's requested mode
The response reports the work actually performed

scenarios.title: Command-line path stays independent of the grant
scenarios.when: An operator runs the destructive command-line invocation with the execute flag
then: The reported outcome matches the operator's requested mode
